votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of September 19, 2023; October 3, 2023; and October 10, 2023, as well as the formal meeting minutes of October 3, 2023.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior meeting minutes from work sessions and a formal session. Standard procedural action to adopt official meeting records.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 32 of 2023 Recognizing December 1st as World AIDS Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall to officially recognize December 1st as World AIDS Day in Salt Lake City. Honors the work of organizations like the Utah AIDS Foundation.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting regarding the Subdivision Code Amendments (Petition No. PLNPCM2023-00494).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed amendments to Title 20 of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to subdivisions and condominiums, with action deferred to a future meeting. The amendments are needed to comply with State code changes by February 1, 2024.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing for the 2023-2024 U.S. Housing and Urban Development General Community Development Needs Annual Public Hearing.
votes.description: Closes the annual HUD public hearing required to gather community input on development needs, informing how the City prioritizes CDBG, ESG, HOME, and HOPWA grant funds.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 65 of 2023 Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 116 East Edith Avenue.
votes.description: Rezones 116 East Edith Avenue from R-1/5,000 to CC (Corridor Commercial District) and amends the Central Community Future Land Use Map from Low-Density Residential to Community Commercial, allowing further commercial and multi-family development.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 66 of 2023 Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at Approximately 1720 South and 1734 South West Temple.
votes.description: Rezones properties at 1720 South and 1734 South West Temple from R-1/5,000 to R-MU-45 and amends the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map from Low-Density Residential to Medium-Density Residential.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 67 of 2023 Historic Preservation Overlay District Text Amendment.
votes.description: Amends various sections of Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to the H Historic Preservation Overlay District to make the ordinance easier to use and creates new processes for adopting and updating historic resource surveys.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 68 of 2023 Alley Vacation at Approximately 1518 South 300 West, with conditions including easements for a publicly accessible mid-block walkway and private drive, restrictions on conveying adjacent property until easements are recorded, and the understanding that 60% or more street level activation plans be memorialized in the planned development and design review process.
votes.description: Vacates City-owned alleys adjacent to properties at 1518, 1528, 1540, and 1546 South 300 West and nearby addresses to allow redevelopment, subject to conditions preserving public access through easements for a walkway and drive.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 69 of 2023 approving the Northpoint Small Area Plan, and initiate Legislative Actions requesting the administration draft new zoning regulations implementing the plan's vision and continue the city-led annexation effort for unincorporated properties in the area.
votes.description: Adopts a land use plan for the area between Salt Lake City International Airport and the City's northern boundary along the 2200 West corridor, and initiates two legislative actions for implementing zoning and annexation.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 33 of 2023 Certification of Downtown Plan, certifying compliance with Utah Code to have station area plans for each transit station.
votes.description: Approves a resolution certifying the Downtown Plan as the station area plan for 13 TRAX and Frontrunner stations in the downtown area to comply with recent state law requirements.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 70 of 2023 Open Space Lands Amendments, amending processes for the disposition of certain interests in City open space lands and governing their removal from the official City Open Space Inventory.
votes.description: Amends the Open Space Lands Ordinance to allow more flexibility for removing certain properties from the Open Space Inventory, granting utility easements, and the sale or exchange of de minimis parcels.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates for several rezones and a budget amendment, and approving board appointments for Robyn Taylor-Granda to the City and County Building Conservation and Use Committee and Landon Kraczek to the Planning Commission.
